Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 qstring varchar2(1000);
 coll_date date;
BEGIN
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :s_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 begin
 select max(coll_date) into coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id 
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and ( ( donor_decision_code = 'S' ) 
 OR 
 ( exists ( select 'x' 
 from unit_attributes
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and attrib_group = 'DON'
 and attrib_code in ( '07', '08', '09', '10', '11', '12')
 )
 )
 ) ;

 if coll_date is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('2331');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 qstring := ' unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and ( (donor_decision_code = ''S'' ) '||
 ' OR ( exists ( select ''x'' from unit_attributes ' ||
 ' where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id ' ||
 ' and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id '||
 ' and attrib_group = ''DON''' ||
 ' and attrib_code in ( ''07'', ''08'', ''09'', ''10'', ''11'', ''12'')' ||
 ' ) '||
 ' ) ) ORDER BY unit_id, coll_date';

 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY( 'UNITS', default_where , qstring) ;
 :ctrl_blk_1.order_by := 'UNIT';
 go_block('units');
 execute_query;
 end if;
 exception
 when no_data_found 
 then 
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('2331');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 qstring1 varchar2(1000); 
 qstring varchar2(1000); 
BEGIN
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.order_by is NULL THEN
 :ctrl_blk_1.order_by := 'UNIT';
 END IF;
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date is NOT NULL AND :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date is NOT NULL THEN 
 qstring1 := ' coll_date between :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date and :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and ( (donor_decision_code = ''S'' ) '||
 ' OR ( exists ( select unit_id from unit_attributes ' ||
 ' where unit_id = units.unit_id '||
 ' and coll_date between :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date and :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date ' ||
 ' and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id '||
 ' and attrib_group = ''DON''' ||
 ' and attrib_code in ( ''07'', ''08'', ''09'', ''10'', ''11'', ''12'')' ||
 ' ) '||
 ' ) )';
 ELSE
 qstring1 := '' ;
 END IF;


 IF :ctrl_blk_1.need_by is NOT NULL 
 OR :ctrl_blk_1.s_surg_date is NOT NULL 
 OR :ctrl_blk_1.s_hosp_id is NOT NULL 
 THEN
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.need_by is NULL 
 AND :ctrl_blk_1.s_surg_date is NULL
 THEN
 IF qstring1 is NOT NULL THEN
 qstring1 := qstring1 || ' and unit_id in ( select su.unit_id from special_units su, transf_details td '||
 ' where su.pat_id = td.pat_id '||
 ' and td.date_needed_by = nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.need_by, td.date_needed_by) ' ||
 ' and td.surg_date = nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_surg_date, td.surg_date) ' ||
 ' and td.hospital_id = nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.hosp_id_dup, td.hospital_id) )' ;
 ELSE
 qstring1 := ' coll_date between sysdate-42 and sysdate and '|| 
 ' unit_id in ( select su.unit_id from special_units su, transf_details td '||
 ' where su.pat_id = td.pat_id '||
 ' and td.date_needed_by = nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.need_by, td.date_needed_by) ' ||
 ' and td.surg_date = nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_surg_date, td.surg_date) ' ||
 ' and nvl(td.hospital_id , ''X'') = nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.hosp_id_dup, nvl(td.hospital_id, ''X'')) )' ;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF qstring1 is NOT NULL THEN
 qstring1 := qstring1 || ' and unit_id in ( select su.unit_id from special_units su, transf_details td '||
 ' where su.pat_id = td.pat_id '||
 ' and td.date_needed_by = nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.need_by, td.date_needed_by) ' ||
 ' and td.surg_date = nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_surg_date, td.surg_date) ' ||
 ' and td.hospital_id = nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.hosp_id_dup, td.hospital_id) )' ;
 ELSE
 qstring1 := ' unit_id in ( select su.unit_id from special_units su, transf_details td '||
 ' where su.pat_id = td.pat_id '||
 ' and td.date_needed_by = nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.need_by, td.date_needed_by) ' ||
 ' and td.surg_date = nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_surg_date, td.surg_date) ' ||
 ' and nvl(td.hospital_id , ''X'') = nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.hosp_id_dup, nvl(td.hospital_id, ''X'')) )' ;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF :ctrl_blk_1.s_pat_id is NOT NULL THEN
 IF qstring1 is NOT NULL THEN
 qstring := qstring1 || ' and unit_id in ( select unit_id from special_units where pat_id = :ctrl_blk_1.pat_id_dup) ' ;
 ELSE
 qstring := ' unit_id in ( select unit_id from special_units where pat_id = :ctrl_blk_1.pat_id_dup) ' ;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF qstring1 is NOT NULL THEN
 qstring := qstring1;
 ELSE
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date');
 show_error('0080','--Atleast one');
 END IF; 
 END IF;


 
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.order_by NOT IN ('UNIT', 'COLL') THEN
 show_error('2319');
 ELSIF :ctrl_blk_1.order_by = 'UNIT' THEN
 qstring := qstring || ' order by unit_id , coll_date' ;
 ELSIF :ctrl_blk_1.order_by = 'COLL' THEN
 qstring := qstring || ' order by coll_date, unit_id ' ;
 END IF;


SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY( 'UNITS', default_where , qstring) ;
:system.message_level :=10;
go_block('units');
execute_query;
:system.message_level :=0;
if :units.unit_id is NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM('s_from_date');
 show_error('2331');
 check_package_failure;
end if;
END;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
:units.chk_digit := chk_digit_query(:units.unit_id, '', '');
 IF :units.donor_decision_code = 'S' THEN
 :units.donor_dec_disp := 'AU' ;
 ELSE
 :units.donor_dec_disp := 'DI' ;
 END IF ;
BEGIN
 SELECT pat_id, seq_no
 INTO :units.patient_id, :units.seq_no
 FROM special_units
 WHERE unit_id = :units.unit_id
 AND coll_date = :units.coll_date
 AND rownum < 2;

 BEGIN
 SELECT InitCap(sp.pat_last_name||', '||sp.pat_first_name) name
 INTO :units.pat_name
 FROM special_patients sp
 WHERE pat_id = :units.patient_id;
 EXCEPTION
 when others then
 :units.pat_name := '';
 END;

 BEGIN
 SELECT td.hospital_id, InitCap(c.short_name) , td.date_needed_by, td.surg_date, td.surg_id, td.comments
 INTO :units.hospital_id, :units.hosp_short_name, :units.d_need_by, :units.surg_date, :units.surg_id, :units.comments
 FROM transf_details td, customers c
 WHERE td.pat_id = :units.patient_id
 AND td.hospital_id = c.customer_id(+) ;
 EXCEPTION
 when no_data_found then
 :units.hospital_id := ''; 
 :units.hosp_short_name := ''; 
 END;
 EXCEPTION
 when others then
 :units.pat_name := 'Unit Not Linked'; 
END;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 SELECT product_type
 INTO :components.product_type
 FROM valid_products
 WHERE product_code = :components.product_code
 AND unit_scheme_type = decode(NVL(length(:components.unit_id), 0), 13, 'I', 'C') ;
EXCEPTION
 when others then 
 :components.product_type := '';
END;


BEGIN
 SELECT code_desc
 INTO :components.sld_des
 FROM master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'ABO'
 AND code = :components.system_label_decision ;
EXCEPTION
 when others then 
 :components.sld_des := '';
END;

BEGIN
 SELECT 'Y'
 INTO :components.ship_prod
 FROM shipped_products
 WHERE unit_id = :units.unit_id
 AND coll_date = :units.coll_date
 AND product_code = :components.product_code
 AND not exists ( select 'x' 
 from return_items
 where unit_id = shipped_products.unit_id
 and coll_date = shipped_products.coll_date
 and product_code = shipped_products.product_code);
EXCEPTION
 when others then 
 :components.ship_prod := '';
END;
